title: GET /api/box/events (200)
description: Source: src/box/routes.ts GET /api/box/events returns { events: loadBoxEvents(limit) }. ENVELOPE is CLOSED. An event is an append-only decision-ledger row (IBoxTradeEvent) whose per-event payload varies by event_type; its element is pinned as an OPEN object, validated against a real (empty) events array from the hermetic engine. The per-leg quote snapshot within an event uses toEventLegs (see box-event-leg.schema.json), exercised directly in the suite.

events.$comment: OPEN element by design: append-only ledger row (IBoxTradeEvent), payload varies by event_type.
